'''Pig rodents''' were a species of large rotund herbivorous creatures, native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. These animals had clawed feet, large rodent-like incisors and long whiskers on their snouts.<ref name="WOSWFG" /> When scared, they could run very fast from danger through the underbrush.<ref name="TCPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

Pig rodents were often hunted by [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]] sometimes used pig rodents as a bait for catching wild rancors in snares.<ref name="WOSWFG" />
